# Usmanian

> Private social network for Usman Public School System (UPSS) students and alumni.

Usmanian is a CID-gated campus network. Membership requires a valid student CID, class, and campus. New accounts stay pending until an admin approves them. Only verified Usmanians can see social data.

## Product facts

- Audience: Usman Public School System students and alumni
- Access model: CID signup → admin approval → verified social access
- Privacy: friend requests need mutual consent; profiles are not public to the open web
- Civic features: Vote for Principal; Report a Teacher (anonymous reporter privacy)
- Official school reference: https://www.usman.edu.pk/

## Public pages

- [Home](https://usmanians-facebook.vercel.app/): Product overview and entry
- [Log in](https://usmanians-facebook.vercel.app/login): Sign in for approved members
- [Sign up](https://usmanians-facebook.vercel.app/signup): Request access with CID

## Private app (not for indexing)

Feed, friends, activity, profile, and admin require an approved session and are closed to search crawlers.

## Contact

- Site: https://usmanians-facebook.vercel.app/
- School system: Usman Public School System (UPSS), Pakistan
